name: M. L. Holley
mentions: M. L. Holley, of Minnesota, partner in the cattle firm of H. B. Wadsworth & Co., has been visiting the ranch for several days. He returned home Tuesday morning.
H. B. Wadsworth, M. L. Holley and D. R. Thorn, arrived Friday night on a visit to the Bad Lands cattle Co's. ranch. They will probably stay at the ranch until the beginning of their beef round-up.
